*   Wait-free sorting avoids hardware-specific pitfalls (e.g., Apple M1) [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that spin-wait-based sorting performs poorly on Apple M1 chips due to a lack of guarantees for workgroup execution order, which leads to busy-waiting. It further confirms that WebSplatter's wait-free design avoids this issue, achieving a significant speedup (over 4.5x) on the M1 compared to the spin-wait baseline. This directly supports the claim that wait-free sorting avoids hardware-specific pitfalls associated with Apple M1.
